problem.descriptionSecondary: Clubnizer is built as a focused alternative to complex club management systems — clean, structured, and designed around what actually matters.
problems: Manual tracking of membership fees with no clear overview
Unclear picture of who has paid and who hasn't
Complicated club systems that take weeks to learn
Too many disconnected tools pulling in different directions
Hours wasted on administration that should be spent on sport
problem.tagline: Clubnizer was built to solve exactly these problems — by someone who lived them.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything You Need to
features.subheading: Five focused pillars of club administration — designed to replace scattered tools with one clear, structured platform for sports team management.

items.title: Member Management
items.description: Keep all your member records organized and accessible. Manage roles, parent and player structures, and maintain a clear overview of everyone in your club.

items.description: Plan sessions, matches and club events with ease. Send invitations and track availability so you always know who's coming.

items.title: Structured Communication
items.description: Targeted communication without chaos. Share announcements and updates at club, group, or subgroup level — reaching the right people with the right information.

founder.label: Our Story
founder.heading: Built From the Sidelines
founder.paragraph1: Clubnizer was created from real involvement in youth sports. Through volunteering as a coach and being closely involved in organizing teams, training sessions and matches, it became clear how much time was spent on administration instead of focusing on the sport itself.
founder.paragraph2: Managing members, tracking attendance and following up on membership fees often felt more complicated than necessary. There were spreadsheets, separate messaging apps, manual payment lists — and none of it talked to each other.
founder.paragraph3: Clubnizer was built to simplify the essentials — creating structure without unnecessary complexity. Not because it was a business idea first, but because there was a genuine need.
founder.goalHighlight: Make organizing sports easier, calmer and more efficient.

security.label: Trust & Compliance
security.heading: Security and Data Protection
security.subheading: Managing a sports club means handling personal data for members — including youth members. We take that responsibility seriously and build Clubnizer with security and data protection at the core.

items.title: Controller & Processor Structure
items.description: Clubs and organizations act as Data Controllers, determining what personal data is entered and maintaining lawful basis. Clubnizer operates as a Data Processor for club member data, handling it only according to club instructions. For account-level data, Clubnizer acts as Data Controller.

items.title: Modern Cloud Infrastructure
items.description: Clubnizer is built on modern cloud infrastructure with encryption in transit and at rest. Access controls and monitoring are in place to help protect against unauthorized access.

items.title: Designed with Data Protection in Mind
items.description: Personal data is handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including GDPR. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to safeguard the data entrusted to us.

items.title: Minimal Data Collection
items.description: We collect and store only the data necessary to provide the service. Clubnizer does not sell personal data and does not use data for advertising purposes.

items.title: Encryption & Access Controls
items.description: Data is protected using industry-standard encryption. Access to systems and data is restricted based on role and necessity, following the principle of least privilege.

items.title: Responsible Deletion Practices
items.description: Deleted accounts and removed memberships are subject to a temporary recovery period before permanent deletion. Clubs may request deletion at any time via support@clubnizer.com.
